No public Main's World API endpoint is callable today.

Main's World publishes reviewed release documentation only. It provides no
server or base URL, sandbox, credentials, self-service keys, public OAuth
registration, public write API, SDK, or MCP endpoint.

- Developers: /developers/
- Apps: /developers/apps/
- API preview: /developers/api/
- Submit an app: /developers/submit-an-app/
- Public catalog: /apps.json
- Full developer catalog: /llms-full.txt
- OpenAPI snapshot: /api/connectives/v1/openapi.json
- Discord example snapshot: /api/connectives/v1/discord-connected-group-membership.json
- Luma example snapshot: /api/connectives/v1/luma-vibe-candidate.json
- Public schema: https://github.com/pixel-potion/mainsworld.org/blob/main/registry/schema/app-v1.schema.json
- Registry instructions: https://github.com/pixel-potion/mainsworld.org/blob/main/registry/README.md
- GitHub submission directory: https://github.com/pixel-potion/mainsworld.org/tree/main/registry/apps
